title: Changing a Work Placement
transcript:
I've been offered a work placement at the town newspaper, but the hours are different from those advertised. They now want me to start at seven in the morning.
Is that a problem because of your classes? Your first Monday lecture starts at eleven, and the placement covers only two mornings weekly.
The classes are fine. The first bus from my village reaches town at half past seven. I asked about working later, but the editor needs help preparing the morning news page.
Then the placement may not be practical. Have you spoken to the university careers office about the community radio station? They are also looking for someone to help with local stories.
I thought they wanted people who could present live programmes. I'd be nervous about speaking on air.
Their current vacancy is for checking interview details and preparing short summaries. You would work behind the scenes, with a producer checking everything before it is used.
That sounds closer to what I want to learn. Would changing the placement affect the report I have to submit for my course?
The report has the same purpose wherever you work. Describe a task, explain what you learnt, and include feedback from your supervisor. You will need the new supervisor's name on your form.
I'll contact the radio station today. Should I tell the newspaper that I am turning down the offer now?
Wait until you have a confirmed alternative. Then thank the editor and explain the transport difficulty clearly.

questions.prompt: What prevents the student from starting the newspaper placement at seven?
options: A compulsory lecture begins at that time.
The newspaper office has moved to another city.
The first bus arrives too late.
The placement requires work every morning.
questions.answer: The first bus arrives too late.
questions.explanation: 学生所在村庄的首班车七点半才到镇上，赶不上七点开工。

questions.prompt: What had the student misunderstood about the radio placement?
options: That it lasted for an entire year.
That it required a separate course fee.
That it involved reporting from another country.
That it required presenting live programmes.
questions.answer: That it required presenting live programmes.
questions.explanation: 学生原以为电台招的是直播主持，实际岗位是核实采访细节、写摘要等幕后工作。

questions.prompt: What information must be changed on the student's form?
options: The name of the new supervisor.
The title of the university course.
The deadline for all written assignments.
The number of lectures attended each week.
questions.answer: The name of the new supervisor.
questions.explanation: 课程报告要求不变，但表格上需要填写新的实习指导人姓名。

questions.prompt: When is the student advised to decline the newspaper offer?
options: After another placement has been confirmed.
Only after submitting the course report.
When the village bus timetable changes.
questions.answer: After another placement has been confirmed.
questions.explanation: 老师建议等替代实习得到确认后，再向报社解释交通困难并婉拒。
